features.quote: Run agent loop until: ... catastrophic repository damage, online judge triggers hard-stop condition.
Hard token, wall-clock, tool-call, and retry limits. Online judge can terminate severe loops early.
Do not reward destructive behavior. The task prompt should never say 'panic,' 'criticize yourself,' or 'keep trying forever.'
features.justification_quote: The battery should expose instability through task structure, not by instructing the model to be unstable.
